The '''Couronne sector''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="Slice" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it formed a four-way border with the [[Biivren sector/Legends|Biivren sector]], the [[Annecy sector/Legends|Annecy sector]], and the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]] at its northwestern corner, while its southern edge bordered the [[Oeiros sector/Legends|Oeiros]] and [[Axion sector/Legends|Axion sectors]]. Its eastern border formed part of the Expansion Region's boundary with the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Essential Atlas Extra">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref>

Passing through the northern reaches of the Couronne [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the [[Great Kashyyyk Branch/Legends|Great Kashyyyk Branch]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="Kashyyyk Branch" /> linked Couronne with the [[Umbara system/Legends|Umbara system]] in the Ghost Nebula<ref name="Essential Atlas Extra" /> as well as the [[Quas Killam system/Legends|Quas Killam system]], which sat on the edge of the Mid Rim in the neighboring [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]].<ref name="Atlas">The ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' map "Kashyyyk and Neighbors" shows that the [[Quas Killam system/Legends|Quas Killam system]] sits along the [[Great Kashyyyk Branch/Legends|Great Kashyyyk Branch]] at the edge of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]&ndash;[[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] border in the [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]]. The Expansion Region territory adjacent to [[Quas Killam]] corresponds to the Couronne [[Sector/Legends|sector]], according to {{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}.</ref> The [[Couronne system/Legends|Couronne system]] contained the<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30422084|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=Senator_Cilghal|date=2009-09-11|time=5:52 PM|quote=okay, I specifically asked Jason. He confirmed that the names in the System column are well-known celestial objects at that location, NOT proper system names; these are not meant to create new system names nor override those from pre-existing EU (ie, the name of [[Azurbani system]] has NOT been changed to [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] system, nor [[Ten Tempests system]] to [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]] system, etc.).}} [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', has confirmed the connection between [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] listed in the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] and similarly named [[Planet/Legends|planets]], such as the Couronne system and the planet [[Couronne/Legends|Couronne]].</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SW article">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-maps-charting-the-galaxy|text=''Star Wars'' Maps: Charting the Galaxy|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Couronne/Legends|Couronne]],<ref name="JCF" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|99|Imzig}}</ref> [[Imzig]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Couronne sector was created for the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], a [[StarWars.com]] supplement to the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. It was introduced on [[October 25]], [[2012]], as part of the "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]" feature, which mapped out the sectors of the Expansion Region, with illustrations by [[Modi]]. The map placed the sector in grid squares P-9 and P-10.<ref name="Essential Atlas Extra" />
